items.reason: The peptide cream you asked for is a gentle, easy daily step for smoother-looking, firmer-feeling skin.
The retinal eye cream you asked for is a low-strength, night-time step to support the look of fine lines around the eyes.
A daily mineral sunscreen is needed alongside a retinal product, and it helps keep skin looking even and youthful.

response.routine_note: Use the retinal eye cream at night only, starting 2 to 3 nights a week and building up as your skin feels comfortable, and apply the peptide cream after it. Use the SPF every morning as the last step, and skip any extra products for now since your scan scores already look strong.
